handoffs.identity_finding: MINOR 1 (open, coord disposition): the image config blob of data.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.0 amd64 says User '1000:1000', so the pre-change process was already 1000:1000 and the pin is faithful on UID. But the image has no /etc/passwd entry for uid 1000 (all four layers dumped), and containerd's WithUserID fallback (identical in release/1.7 oci/spec_opts.go:745-756 and release/2.0 pkg/oci/spec_opts.go:744-762) sets GID=0 for a bare runAsUser ⇒ post-merge the runner's PRIMARY group shifts 1000 -> 0 (uid unchanged). Judged functionally harmless: kubelet merges fsGroup AND supplementalGroups into every container's CRI group list (security_context.go:67-73) so g2375 arrives regardless; and kubelet FsUserFrom (pkg/volume/util/util.go:549-562) bails to nil unless every container (dind included, no runAsUser) resolves the same uid, before AND after ⇒ volume expectation stays root:1000, OnRootMismatch still matches, NO recursive re-chown of the 12Gi VCTs at apply. Adding runAsGroup: 1000 would fully specify identity but exceeds the verbatim ruling '(a) supplementalGroups: [2375] on the runner' + AC2 — reviewer recommends accept-as-is; coord put it to the user.
